purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 20-record item effect batch 018; together these files contain exactly 20 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/rod-alertness-195.name: Rod of Alertness
items/rod-alertness-195.effectSummary: The rod functions as a +1 light mace, grants +1 insight on initiative, and while held can use detect evil, good, chaos, law, magic, discern lies, light, or see invisibility as standard actions. Once per day when planted and activated, it detects creatures within 120 feet intending harm, applies prayer to friendly creatures within 20 feet, mentally alerts those allies for 10 minutes, and it can separately animate up to eleven Small nearby objects for 11 rounds once per day.

items/weirdstone.name: Weirdstone
items/weirdstone.effectSummary: When mentally activated on a flat surface, the floating stone blocks within a 6-mile radius all astral and ethereal travel, divination (scrying), conjuration (teleportation), and abilities or psionics that mimic those effects. It blocks only effects manifesting inside its area, so effects initiated within the radius but targeting locations outside it can still function.

items/vasharan-worm-pod.name: Vasharan Worm Pod
items/vasharan-worm-pod.effectSummary: Forcibly implanting the pod into a helpless creature's stomach deals 3d6 damage; for 2d10 days it grows, dealing 1d4 damage per day. Once mature, the host can expose its tube and up to three times per day spit a worm up to 30 feet as a ranged touch attack; a hit forces Fortitude DC 18 or death in 1d4 rounds, while a successful save instead causes 2d6 damage per round for 1d4 rounds. Remove disease or heal kills the worm, and creatures without discernible anatomy are immune.

items/symrustars-choker.name: Symrustar's Choker
items/symrustars-choker.effectSummary: The choker functions as a wearable wizard spellbook: while wearing it, a wizard can study and prepare any spell stored in it. It can contain up to 36 spells, no more than four of any spell level, and uses the normal rules for deciphering and scribing spells into a spellbook.

items/ruby-robe-of-spellwarding.name: Ruby Robe of Spellwarding
items/ruby-robe-of-spellwarding.effectSummary: While worn, the robe grants +4 resistance on all saving throws. It also functions like a counterspell-storing item that can hold and automatically counter one stored spell of any level from 1st through 9th.

items/ruehars-flute.name: Ruehar's Flute
items/ruehars-flute.effectSummary: Playing two short notes causes the flute to emit light and automatically dispel acid fog, cloudkill, fog cloud, obscuring mist, solid fog, and stinking cloud within that light's radius. A special command word unrolls it into a spellbook able to hold 20 spell levels, whose deciphered spells can be studied and prepared normally by a wizard.

items/rug-of-welcome.name: Rug of Welcome
items/rug-of-welcome.effectSummary: When commanded to guard an area, the 5-by-10-foot rug animates and attacks a Large-or-smaller creature that steps on it, attempting to grab and grapple one target at a time until destroyed or told to release. The owner can set a password for safe passage and issue commands from up to 30 feet away, while the rug can continue guarding without the owner present.

items/scalebane-bottle.name: Scalebane Bottle
items/scalebane-bottle.effectSummary: Once per day, opening the bottle with its command word lets the wielder fire a ray at a creature within 60 feet as a ranged touch attack. On a hit, the target takes -10 to natural armor for 10 minutes, never reducing natural armor below 0 and not affecting enhancement bonuses; there is no saving throw, but spell resistance applies against a 1d20+15 check.

items/shard-of-the-sun-634.name: Shard of the Sun [Relic]
items/shard-of-the-sun-634.effectSummary: For a neutral-good, lawful-good, chaotic-good, or neutral holder, the symbol continuously emits light equivalent to a 5th-level-heightened daylight effect. With the relic connection to Pelor, three times per day it fires two searing-light beams at different targets, each dealing 10d6 to undead, 5d6 to constructs and objects, 5d8 to other creatures, or 10d8 to creatures especially vulnerable to bright light; the stronger qualification raises each activation to four beams with no duplicate target.

items/shield-severed-hand-616.name: Shield of the Severed Hand [Relic]
items/shield-severed-hand-616.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, chaotic-neutral, or neutral-evil wielder, the item functions as a +2 heavy wooden shield. With the relic connection to Gruumsh, after an adjacent opponent attacks the wielder in melee, the shield can trigger an immediate bull rush against that opponent with +4 on the Strength check, without provoking from that opponent; the wielder cannot fall prone or follow the pushed foe.
